tagline: A hidden signal in a drop.
summary: ReNovo is a whole-cell E. coli biosensor for urinary gentisic acid (2,5-dihydroxybenzoic acid), built as a non-invasive early-screening route for renal cell carcinoma (RCC), which is 80-85% of primary kidney malignancies and asymptomatic exactly when it is curable. The team adapted the maleylpyruvate-responsive GtdR/PgtdA system of Cupriavidus necator, deliberately omitting the gtdT transporter from the published circuit to obtain a monotonic, quantifiable dose-response, and used mCherry to dodge urine's green autofluorescence. Because urinary analyte concentration tracks hydration, a parallel colorimetric creatinine assay is run on the same chip and the result is reported as a gentisic acid-to-creatinine ratio in a three-tier risk band. The second-generation sensor PG2 gave a linear response over 0-12 uM (y = 1.094x + 16.8, R2 = 0.9764) with no significant artificial-urine matrix effect and no cross-reactivity to 2-, 3-, 4-HBA or salicyluric acid.
summary_zh: ReNovo 是一個偵測尿中龍膽酸（2,5-二羥基苯甲酸）的全細胞 E. coli 生物感測器，被設計成腎細胞癌（RCC）非侵入式早期篩檢的途徑；RCC 佔原發性腎臟惡性腫瘤的 80-85%，而且偏偏在還可治癒的階段毫無症狀。團隊改用 Cupriavidus necator 中對順丁烯二醯丙酮酸有反應的 GtdR/PgtdA 系統，並刻意把已發表迴路中的 gtdT 運輸蛋白去掉，以取得單調且可量化的劑量反應關係，同時用 mCherry 避開尿液本身的綠色自體螢光。由於尿中分析物濃度會隨補水狀況變動，同一片晶片上還並行一個比色法肌酸酐分析，結果以龍膽酸對肌酸酐的比值、分三級風險區間回報。第二代感測器 PG2 在 0-12 uM 區間呈線性反應（y = 1.094x + 16.8，R2 = 0.9764），在人工尿液基質中沒有顯著的基質效應，對 2-、3-、4-HBA 或水楊尿酸也沒有交叉反應。

dry.frameworks: Business and policy analysis frameworks applied explicitly: PEST analysis of China and global markets, Porter's five forces, SWOT, a marketing-mix positioning exercise, a five-phase evidence-gated development roadmap to 2035 with documented decision gates, and a dated risk register. A concentric three-layer SDG impact model (Inner Core / Proximal Field / Outer Ripple) organises the sustainability analysis by causal distance rather than importance.
dry.frameworks_zh: 明確套用商業與政策分析框架：對中國與全球市場做 PEST 分析、Porter 五力分析、SWOT、行銷組合定位練習、一份延伸到 2035 年、以證據為關卡的五階段開發路線圖並記錄各決策關卡，以及一份註明日期的風險登錄表。另有一個同心三層的 SDG 影響模型（Inner Core／Proximal Field／Outer Ripple），依因果距離而不是重要性來組織永續性分析。
dry.dataviz: Unusually strong, data-first wiki: an interactive GLOBOCAN 2024 choropleth of age-standardised kidney-cancer incidence across 186 countries and territories with the underlying CSV published for download, keyboard-navigable; per-question survey charts that print exact n, option counts and percentages as accessible text; a concentric SDG framework figure and a cross-goal synergy/trade-off figure; an experiment-report calendar.
dry.dataviz_zh: 這是一個資料優先、罕見地紮實的 wiki：一張互動式的 GLOBOCAN 2024 分層著色地圖，呈現 186 個國家與地區的年齡標準化腎癌發生率，底層 CSV 公開供下載，並可用鍵盤操作；逐題呈現的問卷圖表，以無障礙文字印出確切的 n 值、各選項計數與百分比；一張同心的 SDG 框架圖與一張跨目標綜效與取捨圖；以及一份實驗報告日曆。
dry.datascience: Survey instrument run in two waves (n = 131 general awareness; n = 70 product-preference, including a ranked-preference question scored out of 5) with results reported per option and used to justify named design choices. Wet-lab statistics are reported properly: linear regressions with R2 (PG2 0.9764; creatinine Jaffe calibration R2 = 0.98; enzymatic cascade calibration R2 = 0.9614; undiluted induction R2 = 0.9294), two-way ANOVA for matrix effect (concentration p < 0.0001, matrix p = 0.6), one-way ANOVA for reciprocal interference (p = 0.9837), exponential and log-linear fits of positive-cell fraction (R2 = 0.9954 and 0.9723).
dry.datascience_zh: 問卷工具分兩波施測（一般認知 n = 131；產品偏好 n = 70，其中含一題以 5 分計的排序偏好題），結果逐選項回報，並用來支撐他們指名的設計選擇。濕實驗統計也做得規矩：線性迴歸都附 R2（PG2 為 0.9764；肌酸酐 Jaffe 法校正 R2 = 0.98；酵素級聯校正 R2 = 0.9614；未稀釋誘導 R2 = 0.9294）、基質效應用雙因子變異數分析（濃度 p < 0.0001、基質 p = 0.6）、相互干擾用單因子變異數分析（p = 0.9837）、陽性細胞比例則以指數與對數線性擬合（R2 分別為 0.9954 與 0.9723）。
dry.software: No standalone software deliverable. The /software page states plainly that it covers only wiki tools (interactive kidney-cancer map, scientific illustrations, experiment-report calendar) with the implementation in the wiki repository. The /model page is equally candid: it is marked RECORDS PENDING and states that a team model with documented assumptions, parameters, code and validation has not been published, pointing readers to Results instead. A phone mini-program that computes the gentisic-acid-to-creatinine ratio, asks a pre-test aspirin question and prints a tiered report is described as a proposal, not a built artefact.
dry.software_zh: 沒有獨立的軟體產出。/software 頁面直接寫明它只涵蓋 wiki 上的工具（互動式腎癌地圖、科學插圖、實驗報告日曆），實作則放在 wiki 的程式庫中。/model 頁面同樣坦白：它標記為 RECORDS PENDING，並說明團隊並未發表具備完整假設、參數、程式碼與驗證的模型，請讀者改看 Results。一個可計算龍膽酸對肌酸酐比值、在檢測前詢問是否服用阿斯匹靈並印出分級報告的手機小程式，則被描述為一個提案，而不是已經做出來的東西。
techniques: microfluidic chip and optical-reader design with spatial and temporal baseline subtraction against a sealed fluorescent standard
four-enzyme creatinine cascade design with documented interferents (endogenous creatine, hemoglobin)
risk register with gated review points

good.publicEngagement: Two public surveys underpin the engagement work rather than decorating it: n = 131 on awareness (71.76% had only heard the name of kidney cancer, 35.11% had never considered that early RCC is asymptomatic, 57.25% each named hospital queues and fear of invasive procedures as screening barriers) and n = 70 on product expectations (safe handling ranked top at 4.39/5; 61.43% wanted digital confirmation of a colour readout rather than reading it themselves; 61.43% felt only 'somewhat reassured' about engineered bacteria and wanted more safety information; 44.29% wanted a built-in inactivation step before disposal; 58.57% would share anonymised data only with identity confidentiality; 68.57% preferred short science videos and 67.14% detailed articles with charts). Outreach was then built to that evidence: dual-track materials (comics, posters, brochures in English and Chinese, videos for younger audiences; rigorous seminars for senior students and faculty), age-tiered workshops from kindergarten to Grade 11 (LEGO cell models for Grades 1-3, strawberry DNA extraction for Grades 6-8, gel electrophoresis loading and interpretation for IB Grade 11), a presentation for parents and faculty, and WeChat / RedNote / Instagram channels. On Ms. Fiona You's challenge to 'go beyond iGEM', the team committed to a permanent campus Synthetic Biology Club and structured knowledge transfer so the next cohort builds on rather than restarts the work.
good.publicEngagement_zh: 兩份公眾問卷是參與工作的基礎，而不是裝飾：認知調查 n = 131（71.76% 只聽過腎癌這個名字，35.11% 從未想過早期 RCC 是沒有症狀的，各有 57.25% 把醫院排隊與害怕侵入性檢查列為篩檢障礙），產品期待調查 n = 70（安全操作的重要性排名最高，4.39/5；61.43% 希望有數位判讀來確認顏色結果，而不是自己讀；61.43% 對工程菌只覺得有點放心，希望看到更多安全資訊；44.29% 希望丟棄前內建一道去活化步驟；58.57% 只在身分保密的前提下願意分享去識別化資料；68.57% 偏好短科普影片、67.14% 偏好附圖表的詳細文章）。推廣活動就是照這些證據設計的：雙軌素材（漫畫、海報、中英文手冊、給年齡較小觀眾的影片；給高年級學生與教職員的嚴謹研討會）、從幼兒園到 11 年級的分齡工作坊（1-3 年級用樂高做細胞模型、6-8 年級做草莓 DNA 萃取、IB 11 年級做凝膠電泳的上樣與判讀）、一場給家長與教職員的簡報，以及 WeChat、小紅書與 Instagram 頻道。面對 Ms. Fiona You 要他們走出 iGEM 之外的挑戰，團隊承諾成立一個常設的校園合成生物學社團，並建立知識傳承的機制，讓下一屆是在既有成果上繼續，而不是重新開始。
good.ihp: Nineteen named stakeholders across clinical medicine, diagnostics, regulation, bioethics and education, each mapped to the specific project section their input changed - and the changes are real, not cosmetic. The single strongest chain is the circuit redesign: the first-generation gtdR-gtdA-gtdT-mCherry sensor gave a non-monotonic response that peaked around 2 uM and then fell, making quantification impossible. Professor Hangxiang Wang suggested testing lower concentration gradients to check for promoter saturation; the team did, and the non-linearity persisted. Dr. Jing Shi then diagnosed the mechanism from the sequence architecture - the large expressed proteins and heavy transporter expression imposed metabolic strain - and Dr. Tengfei Hu proposed replacing active symport with passive diffusion by excising gtdT to stop intracellular 3-maleylpyruvate over-accumulation. Dr. Christina Feng reinforced it from a different angle: heavy metabolic load creates selection pressure for spontaneous loss-of-function mutations and plasmid clearance, which would make a deployed biosensor unreliable. The team deleted gtdT, and the second-generation PG2 construct restored linearity to R2 = 0.9764. Second chain, normalisation: Dr. Zhou (diagnostics researcher) warned that a single urinary metabolite moves with hydration, diet, medication and age so an elevated reading cannot be distinguished from a concentrated sample, and Dr. Gu (urology director) specifically recommended creatinine correction and first-morning-urine collection, while Dr. Xuan supplied the physiology - before a tumour invades the collecting system, biomarker secretion is very low. The team added a parallel creatinine assay as an internal reference and changed its reported output from raw fluorescence to a gentisic acid-to-creatinine ratio; it then changed chemistry between contexts for a stated reason, keeping the Jaffe picric-acid method for 96-well lab characterisation but switching the device to a four-enzyme cascade because Jaffe responds to non-creatinine urinary compounds and needs strongly alkaline conditions unsuited to dried reagents. Third chain, specificity: Dr. Wu (clinical laboratory physician, Wuxi No. 2 People's Hospital) said routine urine tests cannot separate nephritis or UTI from RCC, and Dr. Zhong warned that herbal medicines and diet confound urinary organic acids; the team ran an artificial-urine matrix panel (Na2HPO4, NaCl, KCl, creatinine, albumin, urea) and a look-alike panel (2-, 3-, 4-hydroxybenzoic acid, salicyluric acid, salicylic acid as the main aspirin metabolite), finding no matrix effect and no cross-reactivity, and added a pre-test aspirin question to the proposed app. Fourth chain, hardware and logistics: Dr. Wu demanded elimination of manual pipetting in favour of a single-use enclosed cassette plus automated reader; Dr. Vargas pointed them to Cologuard's non-contact sample handling as a benchmark; Dr. Christina Feng said in Chinese that she would 'recommend that you consider freeze-drying', naming -40 to -60 C cold chain as a commercial killer, and Dr. Zhong noted community clinics lack refrigeration - so lyophilised cells dried into the chip became the design target. Fifth chain, ethics and framing: Mr. Matthew Peatman argued a false positive is ethically acceptable because it only triggers non-invasive imaging whereas a false negative is disastrous, which set sensitivity as the priority over specificity; he also warned of 'psychosomatic health dysmorphia' from unregulated self-testing, and Dr. Martin Goffriller argued results must stay in the user's own hands, which produced local-only processing, opt-in anonymised data sharing and a three-tier Low/Borderline/Elevated report with an explicit disclaimer instead of a raw number. Dr. Wang Keming's insistence that the device be positioned strictly as a preliminary screening aid rather than a diagnosis is carried through the whole wiki. The notable discipline here is how consistently the team labels unvalidated claims: the 80 C / 20-minute thermal inactivation hold, hydrophobic vent containment, post-lyophilisation viability, and the three-tier cutoffs are each written as 'requires validation' or 'has not yet been demonstrated'.
good.ihp_zh: 十九位具名的利害關係人，橫跨臨床醫學、診斷、法規、生物倫理與教育，每一位都被對應到他們的意見所改動的特定專案章節，而這些改動是真的，不是表面功夫。最有力的一條鏈是迴路重新設計：第一代的 gtdR-gtdA-gtdT-mCherry 感測器反應不是單調的，在約 2 uM 達到高峰之後就下降，使定量變得不可能。Professor Hangxiang Wang 建議測試更低的濃度梯度，檢查是否為啟動子飽和；團隊照做了，非線性仍然存在。接著 Dr. Jing Shi 從序列架構診斷出機制：表現的蛋白質體積大、運輸蛋白表現量又高，造成代謝負擔；Dr. Tengfei Hu 則提議把主動共運輸換成被動擴散，也就是切掉 gtdT，以免細胞內 3-順丁烯二醯丙酮酸過度累積。Dr. Christina Feng 從另一個角度加強這個判斷：沉重的代謝負荷會形成選汰壓力，使自發性功能喪失突變與質體被清除，讓實際部署的生物感測器變得不可靠。團隊刪掉 gtdT，第二代的 PG2 構築把線性恢復到 R2 = 0.9764。第二條鏈是正規化：Dr. Zhou（診斷研究者）警告單一尿中代謝物會隨補水狀況、飲食、用藥與年齡變動，因此讀值偏高和樣本太濃根本分不出來；Dr. Gu（泌尿科主任）具體建議做肌酸酐校正並採集晨尿；Dr. Xuan 則提供生理學基礎：在腫瘤侵入集尿系統之前，生物標記的分泌量非常低。團隊因此加上一個並行的肌酸酐分析作為內部參照，並把回報的輸出從原始螢光值改成龍膽酸對肌酸酐的比值；他們也因為明確的理由，在不同場景改用不同化學方法：96 孔盤的實驗室表徵仍用 Jaffe 苦味酸法，裝置上則改為四酵素級聯，因為 Jaffe 法會對尿中非肌酸酐的化合物起反應，而且需要強鹼條件，不適合乾式試劑。第三條鏈是專一性：Dr. Wu（無錫市第二人民醫院臨床檢驗醫師）指出常規尿液檢查無法把腎炎或泌尿道感染與 RCC 分開；Dr. Zhong 則警告中草藥與飲食會干擾尿中有機酸；團隊因此跑了一組人工尿液基質測試（Na2HPO4、NaCl、KCl、肌酸酐、白蛋白、尿素）與一組結構相似物測試（2-、3-、4-羥基苯甲酸、水楊尿酸，以及阿斯匹靈的主要代謝物水楊酸），結果沒有基質效應、也沒有交叉反應，並在提案中的應用程式裡加入檢測前的阿斯匹靈用藥詢問。第四條鏈是硬體與物流：Dr. Wu 要求取消手動移液，改用一次性的密閉匣加自動判讀儀；Dr. Vargas 指出 Cologuard 的非接觸式樣本處理可作為標竿；Dr. Christina Feng 以中文表示她會建議他們考慮冷凍乾燥，並指出 -40 到 -60 C 的冷鏈在商業上是致命傷；Dr. Zhong 也指出社區診所沒有冷藏設備，於是把凍乾菌體直接乾燥在晶片上成為設計目標。第五條鏈是倫理與表述：Mr. Matthew Peatman 主張偽陽性在倫理上可以接受，因為它只會引導到非侵入性的影像檢查，而偽陰性才是災難，這也確立了靈敏度優先於專一性；他同時警告不受規範的自我檢測可能造成身心性的健康體像障礙；Dr. Martin Goffriller 則主張結果必須留在使用者自己手上，這帶來只在本機處理、選擇加入才分享去識別化資料，以及改用 Low／Borderline／Elevated 三級報告加上明確免責聲明，而不是給一個原始數值。Dr. Wang Keming 堅持這個裝置必須嚴格定位為初步篩檢的輔助工具、而不是診斷，這一點貫徹在整個 wiki 中。特別值得一提的紀律，是團隊標註未驗證主張時有多麼一致：80 C／20 分鐘的熱去活化持溫、疏水排氣孔的圍堵效果、凍乾後的存活率，以及三級分界值，每一項都寫明尚需驗證或尚未被證實。
good.realWorld: The real-world framing is quantified and sourced: 442,570 new kidney-cancer cases and 144,871 deaths worldwide in 2024 (GLOBOCAN), China carrying roughly 18% of cases (80,211) and the highest national mortality (25,029) while sitting below the world age-standardised rate, so the burden is population scale rather than per-capita risk; 93.6% five-year relative survival for localised disease against 20.3% once metastatic; around 60% of cases found incidentally. The SDG case is built on named sub-targets with the team's own evidence rather than a logo wall: SDG 3 (3.4, 3.8, 3.d), 4 (4.4, 4.7, 4.a), 9 (9.1, 9.5, 9.b), 12 (12.4, 12.5, 12.8), 8 (8.2, 8.3, 8.5), 10 (10.2, 10.3, 10.4) and 17 (17.6, 17.16, 17.17), arranged in a concentric model and accompanied by a cross-goal synergy and trade-off analysis. The team also does something most teams skip: it checks its claim against an external commitment, noting that the UICC World Cancer Declaration 2025-2035 target of diagnosing 60% of cancers early is framed around cancers with existing evidence-based screening (breast, cervical, colorectal) and that RCC's absence from that list is precisely the gap. Regulation is specific: the National Medical Products Administration catalogues instruments and in-vitro diagnostic reagents separately and assesses them independently, so the reader and the biologically active chip follow two tracks of different length and the chip governs the launch date; the EU IVDR is cited as a separate conformity regime; China's Cancer Prevention and Control Action Plan 2023-2030 is noted as favouring early detection but not listing kidney cancer. On cost the team refuses a headline number, stating instead that cost per result is dominated by how often the reusable reader is amortised and that it avoids setting a selling price at this stage, while positioning unit cost low enough to be absorbed into a subsidised programme or public insurance, and identifying that payer, decider and beneficiary are three different parties. After the Jamboree: a five-phase evidence-gated roadmap to 2035 with a documented decision gate between phases and a dated risk register (clinical validity 2028, specificity confounded by salicylate or diet 2028, unresolved creatinine-versus-specific-gravity normalisation 2028, production QC variability 2031, regulatory classification or evidence gap 2033), plus the campus Synthetic Biology Club and the Jiangnan University School of Life Sciences link as the institutional carriers.
good.realWorld_zh: 現實世界的鋪陳都有數字也有來源：2024 年全球新增腎癌 442,570 例、死亡 144,871 例（GLOBOCAN），中國約佔其中 18%（80,211 例）並有最高的全國死亡數（25,029 例），但年齡標準化率仍低於世界平均，因此這個負擔是人口規模造成的，而不是個人風險特別高；局部性疾病的五年相對存活率為 93.6%，一旦轉移則降到 20.3%；約 60% 的病例是偶然發現的。SDG 論述建立在指名的子目標與團隊自己的證據上，而不是貼一排標誌：SDG 3（3.4、3.8、3.d）、4（4.4、4.7、4.a）、9（9.1、9.5、9.b）、12（12.4、12.5、12.8）、8（8.2、8.3、8.5）、10（10.2、10.3、10.4）與 17（17.6、17.16、17.17），以同心模型排列，並附一份跨目標的綜效與取捨分析。團隊還做了多數隊伍會跳過的事：把自己的主張對照外部承諾檢核，指出 UICC World Cancer Declaration 2025-2035 關於 60% 癌症早期確診的目標，是圍繞已有實證篩檢方式的癌症（乳癌、子宮頸癌、大腸癌）設定的，而 RCC 不在那份名單上，正好就是那個缺口。法規部分寫得很具體：中國國家藥品監督管理局把儀器與體外診斷試劑分開列管、各自獨立審查，因此判讀儀與具生物活性的晶片走的是兩條長短不同的路，而上市時程由晶片決定；歐盟 IVDR 則被引述為另一套符合性規範；中國的癌症防治行動計畫 2023-2030 被指出雖然支持早期發現，但並未把腎癌列入。成本方面，團隊拒絕給一個標題數字，而是說明每次檢測的成本主要取決於可重複使用的判讀儀被攤提多少次，並表示現階段不訂售價，只把單位成本定位在低到可以被補助方案或公共保險吸收的水準，同時指出付費者、決策者與受益者是三個不同的角色。Jamboree 之後：一份延伸到 2035 年、以證據為關卡的五階段路線圖，各階段之間都有記錄下來的決策關卡，另有一份註明日期的風險登錄表（臨床效度 2028、專一性受水楊酸或飲食干擾 2028、肌酸酐與比重正規化之爭未解 2028、生產品質管制變異 2031、法規分類或證據缺口 2033），以及校園合成生物學社團與江南大學生命科學學院的連結作為制度上的承接者。
partners: Dr. Haiwen Zheng, community hospital physician
Dr. Wang Keming, Head of Oncology, Second Affiliated Hospital of Nanjing Medical University

gemsTakeaway: Copy WUXI-DSAS's stakeholder map that indexes each of nineteen interviewees to the numbered project section their advice changed, so a reader can audit the causal claim; and copy their discipline of writing 'requires validation' next to every unproven design feature (thermal inactivation hold, lyophilisation viability, risk cutoffs) instead of letting a proposal read as a result.
gemsTakeaway_zh: 照抄 WUXI-DSAS 的利害關係人地圖：把十九位受訪者每一位都索引到他們的建議所改動的那個編號專案章節，讓讀者可以稽核這個因果主張；也照抄他們在每一項未經證實的設計特徵旁邊寫上尚需驗證的紀律（熱去活化持溫、凍乾後存活率、風險分界值），而不是讓一個提案讀起來像是已完成的結果。
